identity.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
identity.mission: Create a world-class, emotionally resonant budget app that breaks generic SaaS conventions.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Old Money aesthetics with Cyberpunk precision.
Emotion First: Saving money should feel like leveling up, not a chore.
Content is King: Data is the hero. Legibility is paramount.
Negative Space: Luxurious padding to reduce cognitive load.

rules: Headings (h1-h3) must use Fraunces. Use font-light or font-semibold, never regular.
All currency values > $1,000 must use JetBrains Mono for tabular alignment.
Body text must use Manrope with relaxed leading (leading-relaxed).
Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 for the main dashboard.
Hero Card (Total Balance) spans col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2.
Quick Actions span col-span-full md:col-span-4 row-span-1.
Recent Transactions span col-span-full md:col-span-4 row-span-2.
Never center text in cards unless it's a stat number.

cards.classes: bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-border/50 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300

buttons.primary: rounded-full font-semibold tracking-wide shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all
buttons.secondary: rounded-full border border-border bg-transparent hover:bg-secondary transition-all

inputs.classes: bg-secondary/50 border-transparent focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-lg h-12

visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise texture to the body background (opacity 0.03) to kill the digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Use subtle radial gradients behind the Hero Card: 'bg-gradient-to-br from-primary/10 via-transparent to-transparent'.
visual_enhancers.animations: Use 'framer-motion' for entrance animations. Stagger children by 0.1s.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE TAILWIND CONFIG: Replace the colors in tailwind.config.js with the 'colors' object provided above. Add the fonts to the theme extension.
2. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css.
3. GLOBAL STYLES: Update index.css to apply the base styles (background texture, font families).
4. COMPONENT OVERRIDES: When using Shadcn components (Card, Button, Input), apply the classes defined in 'components' section. Do not use default styles.
5. LAYOUT IMPLEMENTATION: Build the Dashboard using the 'Bento Grid' rules. Ensure the Hero Card is dominant.
6. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards).
7. FILE EXTENSIONS: Use .jsx for all components. Do not use .tsx.
8. CHARTS: Use Recharts with the custom color palette defined in 'chart_colors'.
9. NO AUTH: Build the app assuming a single user context. Mock the user data if necessary for the MVP.

do_not: Do not use gradients for text.
must_do: Ensure all text has sufficient contrast (APCA/WCAG AA).
Add hover states to everything interactive.
